Definition: neuter of a compound of G5259 and G2218; an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e. (specially), a donkey:--ass.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hypozýgion is the word for a beast under the yoke, an ass. In Matthew 21:5, the text says "and sitting upon an ass."
TheologicalSignificance: In hypozýgion I find no hidden theology; it simply means a beast under the yoke, an ass.
